ae.cfg.set.toggle.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the {SET} set (augmentations, chip and crate) can spawn in your save.
OFF{D:OFF}: the set no longer spawns. Items you already have stay in your save. While the set is OFF, its settings are hidden after the next restart. Turn it ON and restart the game to get them back.

Rewards of missions already on the map do not change. Enemies and loot follow this setting in every mission you enter after the restart.
ae.cfg.set.toggle.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：{SET} 套装（增强体、芯片和箱子）可以在你的存档中生成。
关闭{D:OFF}：该套装不再生成。你已拥有的物品会保留在存档中。套装关闭期间，下次重启后其设置会被隐藏。重新开启并重启游戏即可恢复。

地图上已有任务的奖励不会改变。重启后进入的每个任务中，敌人和战利品都会遵循此设置。

ae.cfg.set.toggle.nochip.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the {SET} set (augmentations and crate) can spawn in your save.
OFF{D:OFF}: the set no longer spawns. Items you already have stay in your save. While the set is OFF, its settings are hidden after the next restart. Turn it ON and restart the game to get them back.

Rewards of missions already on the map do not change. Enemies and loot follow this setting in every mission you enter after the restart.
ae.cfg.set.toggle.nochip.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：{SET} 套装（增强体和箱子）可以在你的存档中生成。
关闭{D:OFF}：该套装不再生成。你已拥有的物品会保留在存档中。套装关闭期间，下次重启后其设置会被隐藏。重新开启并重启游戏即可恢复。

地图上已有任务的奖励不会改变。重启后进入的每个任务中，敌人和战利品都会遵循此设置。

ae.cfg.merc.toggle.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the Metabolic Energy Replacement Core (M.E.R.C.) can spawn from tech level 3 on Common, Worker, Miner, Security and Warden enemies and as loot. Dilthey gives it as a reward and sells it from tech level 3.
OFF{D:OFF}: it does not spawn and is not given as a reward or sold. Its recipe can still be unlocked from an augmentation chip.
ae.cfg.merc.toggle.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：从科技等级 3 起，代谢能量替代核心（M.E.R.C.）可能出现在普通、工人、矿工、保安和看守敌人身上，也可能作为战利品出现。迪尔泰从科技等级 3 起将其作为奖励发放并出售。
关闭{D:OFF}：它不会生成，也不会作为奖励发放或出售。仍可通过义体芯片解锁其蓝图。

ae.cfg.augtech.tip.EnglishUS: 1 to 10{D:*}: the higher the level, the later the pieces start to show up in missions, on enemies, in containers and on the ground.
ae.cfg.augtech.tip.ChineseSimp: 1 到 10{D:*}：等级越高，这些部件在任务中（敌人身上、容器中和地面上）出现得越晚。

ae.cfg.augtech.nochip.tip.EnglishUS: 1 to 10{D:*}: the higher the level, the later the pieces start to show up in missions, on enemies, in containers and on the ground.
ae.cfg.augtech.nochip.tip.ChineseSimp: 1 到 10{D:*}：等级越高，这些部件在任务中（敌人身上、容器中和地面上）出现得越晚。

ae.cfg.cratefaction.tip.EnglishUS:
Any faction{D:*}: that faction gives the crate of this set as a mission reward.
none{D:none}: the crate is never given as a reward.

You can take the crate apart to get pieces of this set. It is never found on the ground or sold in a station. A mission reward is the only way to get it.
ae.cfg.cratefaction.tip.ChineseSimp:
任意阵营{D:*}：该阵营会将此套装的箱子作为任务奖励发放。
none{D:none}：箱子永远不会作为奖励发放。

拆解箱子可获得此套装的部件。箱子不会出现在地面上，也不会在空间站出售，只能通过任务奖励获得。

ae.cfg.cratetech.tip.EnglishUS:
1 to 10{D:*}: the higher the level, the later the crate shows up as a reward in the tech tree of the crate faction.

If the crate faction is none, the crate is never given as a reward.
ae.cfg.cratetech.tip.ChineseSimp:
1 到 10{D:*}：等级越高，箱子在箱子阵营的科技树中作为奖励出现得越晚。

如果箱子阵营为 none，箱子永远不会作为奖励发放。

ae.cfg.craftchip.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: you can craft the {SET} chip in the HIS Magnum.
OFF{D:OFF}: you cannot craft the chip. You can still get it from its faction, as a mission reward or in its stations, or find it in missions.
ae.cfg.craftchip.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：你可以在 HIS马格南号上制作 {SET} 芯片。
关闭{D:OFF}：你无法制作该芯片。你仍可从其阵营获得（任务奖励或其空间站），或在任务中找到。

ae.cfg.chipfaction.tip.EnglishUS:
Any faction{D:*}: that faction gives the chip of this set as a mission reward and sells it in its stations. The chip can also be found as loot in missions.
none{D:none}: the chip is never given as a reward and does not spawn at all.
ae.cfg.chipfaction.tip.ChineseSimp:
任意阵营{D:*}：该阵营会将此套装的芯片作为任务奖励发放，并在其空间站出售。芯片也可在任务中作为战利品找到。
none{D:none}：芯片永远不会作为奖励发放，也完全不会生成。

ae.cfg.chiptech.tip.EnglishUS:
1 to 10{D:*}: the higher the level, the later the chip shows up as a reward, in the stations of the chip faction and as loot in missions.

If the chip faction is none, the chip is never given as a reward and does not spawn at all.
ae.cfg.chiptech.tip.ChineseSimp:
1 到 10{D:*}：等级越高，芯片作为奖励、在芯片阵营的空间站中以及在任务中作为战利品出现得越晚。

如果芯片阵营为 none，芯片永远不会作为奖励发放，也完全不会生成。

ae.cfg.piecefaction.tip.EnglishUS:
Any faction{D:*}: in missions against that faction, its enemies can carry the pieces of this set and the pieces can be found as loot. This is on top of the base tags.
none{D:none}: no preferred faction. The set only uses its base tags.

The base tags cannot be changed. The base tags of this set are
ae.cfg.piecefaction.tip.ChineseSimp:
任意阵营{D:*}：在对抗该阵营的任务中，其敌人可能携带此套装的部件，部件也可能作为战利品找到。这是在基础标签之外的额外加成。
none{D:none}：没有偏好阵营。套装只使用其基础标签。

基础标签无法更改。此套装的基础标签为

关闭{D:OFF}：它不会生成，也不会作为奖励发放或出售。仍可通过义体芯片解锁其蓝图。

OFF{D:OFF}: it does not spawn and is not given as a reward or sold. Its recipe can still be unlocked from an augmentation chip.
ae.cfg.gunarm.disc.toggle.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：从科技等级 3 起，（手臂·圆锯发射器）RT-30D 锯木厂可能出现在 PMC 敌人身上以及对抗天命、星核矿业和人民义军的任务中。这些阵营从科技等级 3 起将其作为奖励发放并出售。
关闭{D:OFF}：它不会生成，也不会作为奖励发放或出售。仍可通过义体芯片解锁其蓝图。

ae.cfg.gunarm.shotgun.toggle.label.ChineseSimp: （手臂·霰弹枪）Dual-12G 通牒 生成

ae.cfg.gunarm.shotgun.toggle.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the (Arm Shotgun) Dual-12G Sommation can spawn from tech level 3 on PMC enemies and in missions against RealWare and FrancheComte. These factions give it as a reward and sell it from tech level 3.
OFF{D:OFF}: it does not spawn and is not given as a reward or sold. Its recipe can still be unlocked from an augmentation chip.
ae.cfg.gunarm.shotgun.toggle.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：从科技等级 3 起，（手臂·霰弹枪）Dual-12G 通牒可能出现在 PMC 敌人身上以及对抗真金和弗兰基-康提PS的任务中。这些阵营从科技等级 3 起将其作为奖励发放并出售。

ae.cfg.gunarm.taser.toggle.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the (Arm Taser) D-50KV S.T.I.N.G. can spawn from tech level 3 on PMC enemies and in missions against Dilthey and FrancheComte. These factions give it as a reward and sell it from tech level 3.
OFF{D:OFF}: it does not spawn and is not given as a reward or sold. Its recipe can still be unlocked from an augmentation chip.

开启{D:ON}：从科技等级 3 起，（手臂·电击枪）D-50KV S.T.I.N.G. 可能出现在 PMC 敌人身上以及对抗迪尔泰和弗兰基-康提PS的任务中。这些阵营从科技等级 3 起将其作为奖励发放并出售。

ae.cfg.uhmg.toggle.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the (Arm+Chest) UHMG O'Dakka can spawn from tech level 6 on Military, PMC and Merc enemies and in missions against PlanetBridge, Tianming and RealWare. PlanetBridge and Tianming give it as a reward and sell it from tech level 6, RealWare from tech level 7.
OFF{D:OFF}: it does not spawn and is not given as a reward or sold. Its recipe can still be unlocked from an augmentation chip.
ae.cfg.uhmg.toggle.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：从科技等级 6 起，（手臂+胸部）UHMG 奥丁弹雨可能出现在军方、PMC 和佣兵敌人身上，以及对抗星桥、天命和真金的任务中。星桥和天命从科技等级 6 起将其作为奖励发放并出售，真金从科技等级 7 起。

ae.cfg.gunarm.mode.tip.EnglishUS:
Vanilla{D:Vanilla}: the arm blocks the primary weapon slot, like the vanilla weapon arms.
Extra slot{D:Extra slot}: the arm blocks the primary weapon slot and opens the third weapon slot.
Bare hands only{D:Bare hands only}: no slot is blocked or added. The arm only replaces your bare hands weapon.

Arms already installed switch mode when the save is loaded. If the primary slot gets blocked, or the third slot closes, its weapon moves to the backpack or vest. If they are full, it goes to the ship cargo, or to the ground during a mission.

Affected items (tagged as Special Weapon Arm)
ae.cfg.gunarm.mode.tip.ChineseSimp:
Vanilla{D:Vanilla}：手臂会封锁主武器栏位，与原版武器手臂相同。
Extra slot{D:Extra slot}：手臂会封锁主武器栏位，并开启第三武器栏位。
Bare hands only{D:Bare hands only}：不封锁也不增加任何栏位。手臂只替换你的徒手武器。

已安装的手臂会在读取存档时切换模式。如果主武器栏位被封锁，或第三武器栏位关闭，其中的武器会移到背包或背心。如果它们已满，武器会移到货舱，任务中则掉落在地面上。

受影响的物品（带有“特殊武器手臂”标记）

ae.cfg.modconfig.note.EnglishUS: FROM HERE YOU CAN CHANGE THE MOD CONFIG FOR EACH SET AND SETLESS ITEM ADDED BY AUGMENTATIONS EXPANDED.
ae.cfg.modconfig.note.ChineseSimp: 你可以在这里修改 AUGMENTATIONS EXPANDED 添加的每个套装和无套装物品的模组设置。

ae.cfg.restart.note.EnglishUS: REMEMBER TO RESTART THE GAME FOR ANY CHANGE MADE IN THIS MENU TO TAKE EFFECT
ae.cfg.restart.note.ChineseSimp: 请记得重启游戏，本菜单中的更改才会生效

ae.cfg.vamode.tip.EnglishUS:
Requires Visible Augments. This changes how augment 3D models interact with the armor you wear.

Clip{D:Clip}: both are shown and can clip, as in Visible Augments.
Hide armor{D:Hide armor}: augments hide the armor on the same body part.
Hidden by armor{D:Hidden by armor}: armor hides the augments under it.
Off{D:Off}: no Augmentations Expanded models are shown.

As in vanilla Visible Augments, the Head augments always hide the worn helmet regardless of the chosen config.
ae.cfg.vamode.tip.ChineseSimp:
需要 Visible Augments。此设置会改变增强体 3D 模型与你所穿护甲的互动方式。

Clip{D:Clip}：两者都会显示，可能互相穿模，与 Visible Augments 相同。
Hide armor{D:Hide armor}：增强体会隐藏同一身体部位上的护甲。
Hidden by armor{D:Hidden by armor}：护甲会隐藏其下方的增强体。
Off{D:Off}：不显示任何 Augmentations Expanded 模型。

与原版 Visible Augments 相同，无论选择哪种设置，头部增强体始终会隐藏所戴的头盔。

ae.cfg.handfootrecipe.label.EnglishUS: Hand and foot required in recipes

ae.cfg.handfootrecipe.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the crafting recipe of the full arm of a set (shoulder and arm in one piece) needs the hand of the same set, and the crafting recipe of the full leg (thigh and foot in one piece) needs the foot of the same set, like the vanilla limbs.
OFF{D:OFF}: the hand and the foot are removed from those crafting recipes. The arm and the leg are crafted from parts only.
ae.cfg.handfootrecipe.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：套装整臂（肩部和手臂为一体）的制作蓝图需要同一套装的手部，整腿（大腿和足部为一体）的制作蓝图需要同一套装的足部，与原版肢体相同。
关闭{D:OFF}：这些制作蓝图不再需要手部和足部。手臂和腿部只用零件制作。

ae.cfg.rankrestriction.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: a clone can install the pieces of a set only after it reaches the Minimum clone rank chosen in that set's section. Until then the Augment command is greyed out, and the tooltip of the piece shows the rank it needs.
OFF{D:OFF}: any clone can install any piece. The Minimum clone rank of the sets is ignored.

Only your clones are affected. Enemies still spawn with the pieces. Pieces already installed are not removed.
ae.cfg.rankrestriction.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：克隆体只有达到该套装设置中选择的“最低克隆体等级”后，才能安装该套装的部件。在此之前，“安装增强体”命令会变灰，部件的提示框会显示所需等级。
关闭{D:OFF}：任何克隆体都可以安装任何部件。各套装的“最低克隆体等级”将被忽略。

只影响你的克隆体。敌人仍会携带这些部件生成。已安装的部件不会被移除。

ae.cfg.multislotloss.label.ChineseSimp: 多部位增强体截肢后销毁

ae.cfg.multislotloss.tip.EnglishUS:
What happens at the end of a mission when a clone loses one wound slot of a Multi-WoundSlot augmentation to an amputation.

ON{D:ON}: vanilla behaviour. The whole augmentation is destroyed, and the implants on its other wound slots go back to the cargo.
OFF{D:OFF}: the amputated wound slot grows back and the augmentation stays installed. The implants on the amputated wound slot are lost. The implants on the other wound slots stay installed. The clone still needs the usual healing time for the amputation.

Affected items (tagged as Multi-WoundSlot)
ae.cfg.multislotloss.tip.ChineseSimp:
当克隆体的多部位增强体有一个身体部位被截肢时，任务结束后会发生什么。

开启{D:ON}：原版行为。整个增强体被销毁，其他身体部位上的植入物回到货舱。
关闭{D:OFF}：被截肢的身体部位会重新长出，增强体保持安装。被截肢部位上的植入物会丢失，其他部位上的植入物保持安装。克隆体仍需要截肢的正常恢复时间。

受影响的物品（带有“多部位”标记）

ae.cfg.minrank.tip.EnglishUS:
Any rank{D:*}: clones of this rank or higher can install the pieces of the {SET} set.

Works only when Clone rank restriction is ON in GENERAL MOD SETTINGS.
ae.cfg.minrank.tip.ChineseSimp:
任意等级{D:*}：达到此等级或更高等级的克隆体可以安装 {SET} 套装的部件。

仅在“通用模组设置”中开启“克隆体等级限制”时生效。

ae.cfg.pmc.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the {SET} pieces can also spawn on enemies that use the PMC tag, such as PMC soldiers, assassins and bounty hunters. This is on top of the tags and the preferred faction of the set.
OFF{D:OFF}: these enemies only carry the pieces if another tag of the set matches them.
ae.cfg.pmc.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：{SET} 部件也可能出现在使用 PMC 标签的敌人身上，例如 PMC 士兵、刺客和赏金猎人。这是在套装标签和偏好阵营之外的额外加成。
关闭{D:OFF}：只有当套装的其他标签与这些敌人匹配时，他们才会携带这些部件。

ae.icons.info.note.ChineseSimp: 你可以在这里更改 AUGMENTATIONS EXPANDED 添加的套装和无套装物品的像素画。默认图片名为“DEFAULT - FOXYLA36”，其他所有图片都来自决定用自己的作品改进本模组的热心人和出色的画师！如果你想为本模组的物品制作图片，只需在 DISCORD/STEAM 上添加 FOXYLA36 为好友并把图片发给我！唯一的要求是图片必须符合原版美术风格，且尺寸不超过 24X24 / 48X24 像素

ae.icons.adaptive.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the inventory size of items drawn with an icon pack follows the art. An icon up to 24 pixels wide takes 1 cell, a wider one takes 2 cells.
OFF{D:OFF}: every item keeps its standard size, 1x1 for M.E.R.C. and the chips and 2x1 for every other augmentation and the crates.

Items with the default art always keep their standard size. Items already in your save keep their old size. An augment takes the new size only after you install it on a clone and remove it again, and crates and chips you already own never change. New drops, crafts and rewards use the new size. Restart the game to apply this option.
ae.icons.adaptive.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：使用图标包绘制的物品，其物品栏尺寸会跟随图片。宽度不超过 24 像素的图标占 1 格，更宽的占 2 格。
关闭{D:OFF}：每个物品保持标准尺寸：M.E.R.C. 和芯片为 1x1，其他增强体和箱子为 2x1。

使用默认图片的物品始终保持标准尺寸。存档中已有的物品保持旧尺寸。增强体只有在安装到克隆体上再移除后才会采用新尺寸，你已拥有的箱子和芯片永远不会改变。新的掉落、制作和奖励会使用新尺寸。重启游戏以应用此选项。

ae.icons.items.label.ChineseSimp: 物品图标（物品栏 + 地面）

ae.cfg.set.toggle.nocrate.tip.EnglishUS:
ON{D:ON}: the {SET} set (augmentation and chip) can spawn in your save.
OFF{D:OFF}: the set no longer spawns. Items you already have stay in your save. While the set is OFF, its settings are hidden after the next restart. Turn it ON and restart the game to get them back.

Rewards of missions already on the map do not change. Enemies and loot follow this setting in every mission you enter after the restart.
ae.cfg.set.toggle.nocrate.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启{D:ON}：{SET} 套装（增强体和芯片）可以在你的存档中生成。
关闭{D:OFF}：该套装不再生成。你已拥有的物品会保留在存档中。套装关闭期间，下次重启后其设置会被隐藏。重新开启并重启游戏即可恢复。

地图上已有任务的奖励不会改变。重启后进入的每个任务中，敌人和战利品都会遵循此设置。

ae.cfg.augtech.single.tip.EnglishUS: 1 to 10{D:*}: the higher the level, the later the augmentation starts to show up in missions (on enemies, in containers and on the ground) and as a reward from its reward faction.
ae.cfg.augtech.single.tip.ChineseSimp: 1 到 10{D:*}：等级越高，该增强体在任务中（敌人身上、容器中和地面上）出现得越晚，其奖励阵营将其作为奖励发放的时间也越晚。

ae.cfg.rewardfaction.tip.EnglishUS:
Any faction{D:*}: that faction gives the augmentation as a mission reward, starting from the tech level of the augmentation.
none{D:none}: the augmentation is never given as a reward.

This set has no crate, so this takes its place.
ae.cfg.rewardfaction.tip.ChineseSimp:
任意阵营{D:*}：该阵营会从该增强体的科技等级起，将其作为任务奖励发放。
none{D:none}：该增强体永远不会作为奖励发放。

此套装没有箱子，因此由此选项代替。

ae.cfg.enemyaugchance.tip.EnglishUS:
How often enemies get augmentations.
Each enemy rolls for augmentations when it spawns, and most rolls fail. This makes more of them succeed. Which augmentation they get is not affected.

0 to 100{D:*}: percentage of failed rolls that succeed instead. 0 is vanilla.
E.g. a common enemy fails 87% of its rolls: at 50 it fails 43%, at 100 never.

Due to how the game works, an enemy might still spawn without augmentations even with both settings at max.
Too many augmentations can lower an enemy's max HP a lot.
Applies to newly spawned enemies.
ae.cfg.enemyaugchance.tip.ChineseSimp:
敌人获得增强体的频率。
每个敌人生成时都会为增强体进行判定，而大多数判定会失败。此选项让更多判定成功，不影响获得哪种增强体。

0 到 100{D:*}：原本失败的判定中改为成功的百分比。0 为原版。
例如：普通敌人有 87% 的判定会失败；设为 50 时失败率为 43%，设为 100 时永不失败。

由于游戏机制，即使两项设置都调到最大，敌人仍可能不带增强体生成。
过多的增强体可能大幅降低敌人的最大生命值。
仅对新生成的敌人生效。

ae.cfg.enemyaugrolls.tip.EnglishUS:
How many augmentations an enemy can get.
Gives each enemy more rolls, so it can spawn with more augmentations at once (one per body part at most). Each roll still uses Enemy aug chance.

0 to 9{D:*}: rolls added to each enemy. 0 is vanilla.

Due to how the game works, an enemy might still spawn without augmentations even with both settings at max.
Too many augmentations can lower an enemy's max HP a lot.
Applies to newly spawned enemies.
ae.cfg.enemyaugrolls.tip.ChineseSimp:
敌人可以获得多少个增强体。
为每个敌人增加判定次数，使其能同时带着更多增强体生成（每个身体部位最多一个）。每次判定仍使用“敌人增强体概率”。

0 到 9{D:*}：为每个敌人增加的判定次数。0 为原版。

由于游戏机制，即使两项设置都调到最大，敌人仍可能不带增强体生成。
过多的增强体可能大幅降低敌人的最大生命值。
仅对新生成的敌人生效。
